axes.behavior: Complete 170-byte native callback: superclass call precedes creative/removed guards; then discard, configured cloud submission and null-source BLOCK explosion request, conditional on normal upstream return.
axes.costs: Native ItemEntity.discard precedes both submissions; no stack decrement, mana, cooldown or refund path. Submission return values are ignored; accepted world effects or transactional settlement are not established.
axes.identity: Publisher 1.0.10 SHA-1/SHA-256/size; abstract two-argument interface declaration and sole concrete publisher implementer, with complete typed hierarchy/member census.
axes.integration: ACBlockRegistry selector 5/WASTE_DRUM supplier bridge, constructors, relocated Citadel one-argument callback, ACCompat color/effect bridges and bounded native IRRADIATED consumer. Matching-version NeoForge reference proof is a separate boundary.
axes.parameters: Cloud GAMMAROACH/color 7853582/IRRADIATED 9600 amplifier 1/radius 2/duration 12000/wait 0/negative-radius-over-duration; explosion 1.8 at Y+0.5. Factory selector 5 constructs with 0.01, an inherited inventory field, not callback RNG.
axes.targeting: Callback receives ItemEntity and DamageSource; no owner assignment or entity search in the callback. Cloud and explosion consumers perform external selection. Finite native IRRADIATED consumer is recorded separately from cloud application.
axes.validation: All 1555 class entries, typed owner/declaration/member/hierarchy censuses, reconciled JVM declarations/full selected bodies, explicit operand/branch/switch/bootstrap pivots, immutable seal and twice-run physical-binary CLI. Gameplay remains NOT_TESTED.

callback_semantics.input_policy: No local null guards or explicit ownership authorization. DamageSource is dereferenced after superclass return; ItemEntity is subsequently dereferenced. No accepted world change, permission decision or settlement follows from those facts.

upstream_call.causal_bound: Every local guard and effect below offset 6 requires normal return from the superclass call. Matching-version NeoForge default bridges are separately evidenced reference inputs; actual installed transformed dispatch remains unverified.

integration_bounds.color_bridge: ACCompat.setCloudColor installs PotionContents with empty base potion, Optional.of(color), empty effect list; native callback adds its effect afterwards.
integration_bounds.constructor_chance: Factory 0.01 is stored as inherited randomChanceOfRadiation; inventory tick multiplies it by stack count and (1 - hazmat_count/4), checks existing IRRADIATED and RNG, requests duration 1800. The destroyed callback neither reads the field nor samples RNG.
integration_bounds.cost: Discard is requested before cloud/explosion; no mana/cooldown/cast/stack decrement/refund or transactional world settlement in the callback.
integration_bounds.effect_bridge: ACCompat.effect wraps BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT through Registry.wrapAsHolder; registry realization and accepted engine effects are external.
integration_bounds.excluded: Installed class transformation/execution, accepted cloud/entity/effect/explosion/damage outcomes, world destruction and protection rules, event cancellation, network authorization, external consumers, perks/hooks and physical gameplay.
integration_bounds.native_status_consumer: IRRADIATED shouldTick rejects amplifier <=0; otherwise interval=200/amplifier, periodic duration%interval==interval/2 if interval>1, else true. At amplifier1 the native predicate is duration%200==100. Engine cloud duration transforms and scheduling are external.
integration_bounds.native_status_tick: Hazmat count is four exact item identities; resistance=1-count*0.25. Unprotected Player requests exhaustion0.4. Raycat bypasses hurt. Other entities request radiation hurt(resistance) only if randomFloat < resistance+0.1; hurt return ignored. Native hurt request is not accepted damage.
integration_bounds.relocated_callback: One-argument BlockItemWithSupplier callback tests the supplied block for ShulkerBoxBlock, resets CONTAINER to EMPTY, and invokes ItemUtils.onContainerDestroyed on prior non-null contents. It has no discard call. It is a different JVM descriptor from ACDestroyedItem.

registration_bridge.limit: Native registration declarations and supplier construction only; engine registration lifecycle, realized registry instances and installed execution are not physically tested.

typed_reference_census.limit: Publisher classfile closure only; reflective name construction, external mods, transformed runtime classes and future versions are not closed.
typed_reference_census.method: Typed Class/Fieldref/Methodref/InterfaceMethodref/NameAndType/MethodType plus declared JVM descriptors; plain UTF8/String constants do not count.

validation.authority: SHA-exact publisher binary, not adjacent source.
validation.reproduction: Mandatory exact seal comparison; native semantic/census negatives and twice-run physical-binary CLI idempotence.
